source.citation: GD CFO prepared remarks on the October 30, 2026 Q3 call. Full-year cash capex of 3.5% to 4.0% of sales and approximate issuer free cash flow conversion of 105% of net earnings. Quartr transcript via Stock Analysis, cross-checked against The Motley Fool transcript.

base.rationale: Allocate both operating cash and capex using the share of calendar days remaining in Q4.

lower_remaining_cash.rationale: Stress-test 10 percentage points less operating cash and 10 points more capex after the cutoff.

higher_remaining_cash.rationale: Stress-test 10 percentage points more operating cash and 10 points less capex after the cutoff.
